decisions.reason: The client explicitly selects a 0.68-inch spine width only for the separate D2D cover; the Amazon-specific 0.75-inch specification remains unchanged.
Selecting the D2D spine width does not change the requirement that title typography remain consistent across the cover.
The D2D spine-width decision does not alter the approved blurb replacement or back-cover text reflow.
The source changes only the D2D cover's spine width and does not modify text-rendering or font-portability requirements.
Proceeding with the D2D cover does not explicitly change the required PSD, PDF, and JPG deliverable formats or the layered-PSD requirement.
The D2D-specific spine-width selection does not affect Amazon PDF upload compatibility or the smaller backup export.
